config.score_weight_search: Fixed after acceleration sensitivity testing: Current Performance 65%, Momentum 15%, Acceleration 5%, Stability 15%. The first 30 days are retained as a calibration/validation period; the next 30 days are the unseen evaluation.
config.anomaly_policy: diagnostic only; excluded from ranking and movement
config.movement_rule: Adaptive daily movement: signal strength from evidence, momentum and acceleration sets base movement pressure; persistence acts as a multiplier that increases movement only when evidence is meaningful; established strong games receive protection from abrupt downward replacement.
config.missing_data_policy: Missing values remain missing. Selected-day No Data displays as No Data, and the game holds its previous website position.
config.signal_timing: Ranking signals use only data available before the evaluation day; selected-day raw values are evaluation-only.
